# QuranWall

> QuranWall (App Store title "Quran Widget: QuranWall") is an iPhone app that puts an ayah of the Quran on the Lock Screen wallpaper and a Home Screen widget, with the Uthmani Arabic beside a translation. It is free to download, with an in-app subscription.

## Key facts

- **What it is**: an iPhone app that shows an ayah of the Quran on the Lock Screen wallpaper and Home Screen widget
- **Platform**: iPhone, iOS 15.0 or later (App Store listing)
- **Price**: free to download, with an in-app subscription. The App Store shows the price before you subscribe.
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/quran-verse-lock-screen/id6781802080?pt=128303795&ct=qw-web-llms&mt=8
- **Website**: https://quranwall.com
- **Author / Founder**: Karol Billik
- **Built by**: karchi. (https://www.karchi.xyz/)
- **Contact**: iosnotewall@gmail.com

## Pricing

The download is free, with an in-app subscription. QuranWall states no prices here: the App Store shows the exact price and billing period before you subscribe, in your local currency, and these vary by region and over time. Purchases are processed through the App Store.

## What it does

- Puts an ayah on the iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper and on a Home Screen widget
- Shows Uthmani Arabic beside a translation, in 10 languages
- Lets you choose your own background (a preset or your own photo), font and colours
- All 114 surahs are searchable by surah, ayah or keyword
- No ads, and it works offline

## What it does not do

No audio recitation, tafsir, hifz tools, prayer times or qibla. There is no AI feature, no Android app and no web app.
